snippets.title: Binary Search (Iterative & Robust)
snippets.notes: Avoid integer overflow by using low + (high - low) / 2 instead of (low + high) / 2. Array must be sorted.

snippets.title: Two Sum using HashMap (O(N) Time)
snippets.notes: Single pass hash table approach. Complements are checked in O(1) average time.

snippets.title: Reverse a Singly Linked List (Iterative)
snippets.notes: Three pointers: prev, curr, next. In-place reversal with O(1) extra space.

snippets.title: LRU Cache (HashMap + Doubly Linked List)
snippets.notes: O(1) get and put operations by combining a Hash Map with a Doubly Linked List for tracking least recently used items.

snippets.title: Runtime Polymorphism (Dynamic Method Dispatch)
snippets.notes: Demonstrates dynamic binding where method call is resolved at runtime based on the actual object instance, not reference type.

snippets.title: Thread-Safe Singleton (Bill Pugh Implementation)
snippets.notes: Bill Pugh singleton uses static inner helper class. Thread-safe without explicit synchronization overhead, loaded only on first call.

snippets.title: Factory Method Pattern with Extensibility
snippets.notes: Decouples object creation logic from caller code. Adheres to Open-Closed Principle (OCP).

snippets.title: Stream API Pipeline: Filter, Map & Collect
snippets.notes: Demonstrates declarative data processing: filtering, transforming, sorting, and grouping items into maps.

snippets.title: ExecutorService & ThreadPool Concurrency
snippets.notes: Thread management using FixedThreadPool. Avoid manually creating new Thread() objects to prevent resource exhaustion.

snippets.title: CompletableFuture Asynchronous Chaining
snippets.notes: Non-blocking async pipelines with thenApply, thenCompose, and exception handling using exceptionally.
